Checks the key against the API (GET /org) and stores it in the OS keychain, or in
~/.config/kaab/credentials.toml (0600) when there is no keychain. A profile holds one live and
one test key; --test then selects the test one.

Usage:
  kaab auth login [flags]

Flags:
      --file-storage          keep the key in credentials.toml rather than the OS keychain
  -h, --help                  help for login
      --key string            the API key (read from stdin when absent)
      --org string            a note naming the organisation (its name by default)
      --panel-url kaab open   the panel's URL, for kaab open (https://app.kaab.ist by default)

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)
